scope: One token, four fixed depth-source vectors; not a complete Transformer
rmsGain: unit gain; fixed local teaching convention
boundaryScope: At the first sublayer of a new block only embedding/completed blocks are candidates: omit the absent partial, rather than append a zero vector. Attention and FFN count as separate sublayers.
gradientScope: For Full and Block separately, differentiate the same four original source vectors and the learned query (15 local coordinates each). Block-source gradients are returned through their fixed sums. No upstream sublayer weights or gate gains are trained.
